item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Receives 'Unbelievable' Emotional Gift From YUNGBLUD Before Final BLACK SABBATH Performance in Birmingham; VIDEO
item.description: As Ozzy Osbourne prepared to take the stage one last time with Black Sabbath, another artist was waiting backstage with something a bit unexpected. Yungblud, the genre-bending musician from Doncaster, brought more than just his performance to Villa Park in Birmingham.

item.title: The Words JAMES HETFIELD Waited Decades To Say Onstage To BLACK SABBATH At Their Final Show
item.description: Metallica showed up in full force at Back to the Beginning, a farewell event held on July 5 at Villa Park in Birmingham, England. The show was designed to mark the final chapter for Black Sabbath as a live band, as well as the last-ever solo performance by Ozzy Osbourne.

item.title: DISTURBED's DAVID DRAIMAN Booed by Some Fans at BLACK SABBATH's Final Show; VIDEO
item.description: Disturbed’s frontman David Draiman stepped onto the stage at Back to the Beginning, the all-star farewell concert for Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath, and was met with a crowd that didn’t quite know how to respond (watch below).

item.title: OASIS Plays Historic First Show in 16 Years as NOEL GALLAGHER Dedicates Song to Young Fans: 'You Kept Us Hot for 20 Years'
item.description: Oasis is officially back. The British rock band returned to the stage this weekend for the first time in 16 years, kicking off their long-awaited reunion tour in front of a packed crowd at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, Wales.

item.title: Ex-Asking Alexandria DENIS STOFF Reacts To Viral Warped Tour Backlash: 'I Laughed My Tits Off'
item.description: Former Asking Alexandria frontman Denis Stoff has spoken out about recent criticism aimed at current vocalist Danny Worsnop, following a performance that disappointed many fans. The band’s June 15 livestream at the Vans Warped Tour in Washington, D.

item.title: LIMP BIZKIT's WES BORLAND Cosplays As Skull-Faced JAMES HETFIELD At Metallica’s Denver Show
item.description: Limp Bizkit guitarist Wes Borland turned heads at Metallica’s Denver show on Friday by dressing up like a skull-faced version of 1980s James Hetfield (watch below). The look included a “Metal Up Your Ass” t-shirt and white high-top sneakers, all while performing a full 10-song set.

item.title: The Two METALLICA Songs JAMES HETFIELD Finds 'Truly Difficult' To Perform Live: 'Really Messes With Me'
item.description: Metallica has been around for over 40 years, and their music is known for being fast, loud, and often complex. But for frontman James Hetfield, two songs from their 2008 album Death Magnetic still stand out as especially difficult to play live.

item.title: Linkin Park’s EMILY ARMSTRONG Shaves Fan's Head on Stage at ROCK FOR PEOPLE 2025
item.description: Linkin Park opened their summer festival season with a big moment at Rock for People 2025. The band performed in front of 50,000 fans, but one person in the crowd definitely stood out.

item.title: The One AC/DC Song ANGUS YOUNG Struggles to Play Live
item.description: Few bands are as famously built on no-nonsense riffs as AC/DC. For Angus Young and his brother Malcolm, there was no mystery to their formula: loud guitars, open chords, and choruses made for the crowd to scream in unison.

item.title: When METALLICA Brought Back 'FRANTIC' Live And JAMES HETFIELD Roasted St. Anger
item.description: Back in 2021, Metallica briefly resurrected “Frantic”, the chaotic opener from their 2003 punching bag of an album, St. Anger. The band pulled the song out of retirement for a set at the Aftershock Festival on October 8 (watch the video below), years after it had mostly vanished from live shows following a few scattered appearances in 2019 and a much longer break since 2011.

item.title: KORN Praises SLEEP TOKEN's Download Festival Show: 'They Outdid a SLIPKNOT Stage'
item.description: The members of Korn had high praise for Sleep Token following their performance at the Download Festival on Saturday, June 14. According to the band, the masked group managed to silence skeptics with a massive stage setup and commanding live presence.
